title: Starter Kit Racing
description: Chase lap times around a toy-box circuit, then build a track of your own.
author: mrdoob
ai_note: Ported to JavaScript with Claude by mrdoob. Original starter kit and CC0 assets by Kenney.

title: Fly Pieter
description: Take off into a shared low-poly world. Try landing in one piece.
author: Pieter Levels
ai_note: The creator describes this as made with AI using Cursor and Three.js. Optional paid extras are offered on the game site.

title: Riposte: Frontline
description: A browser FPS with classes, bot matches, and online lobbies.
author: BenDBS
ai_note: The creator credits Claude Code in the game's footer. Source is published by BenDBSS.

title: Three.js Quake
description: Quake's shareware first episode, ported to the browser with Three.js.
author: mrdoob · original by id Software
ai_note: Browser port by mrdoob with Claude. Original game by id Software; this is a port, not an AI-created original game.

title: Sillage
description: Swim through an illustrated microscopic world. Follow the currents, meet strange creatures, and take your time.
author: Denis Hovart
ai_note: The creator describes using LLMs to implement the game and shaders in their October 23 Show HN post. They did not name a model.

title: Tiberava
description: Build a Roman city, balance its economy, keep your citizens supplied, and prepare for trouble.
author: cayodister
ai_note: The creator calls this their vibe-coded game in an October 22 Show HN update. The post does not specify an AI tool.

title: Mine Rogue
description: Minesweeper with a roguelike shop: survive harder boards, buy strange bonuses, and chase bigger scores.
author: aeonfr
ai_note: The creator says they used Claude Opus 5.5, React, and 98.css in their October 21 HN launch comment.

title: Daily Pipes
description: Rotate the tiles until every pipe connects. A new daily puzzle, designed to be solved without guessing.
author: jkelle
ai_note: The creator says Claude implemented almost all the code in their October 21 Show HN post. The daily puzzle is free; an archive is advertised separately.

title: Haiku Harbour
description: Wander through a seaside town filled with NPCs and other players. A little world to get lost in.
author: Chong-U (@chongdashu)
ai_note: The creator credits Claude Haiku 5.5 in their October 8 X post. The linked game page also names the creator and model.

title: Netherspace
description: Neo just woke up. Jump through a platforming world that takes shape as you bump into questions.
author: esha (@eshpvt)
ai_note: The creator says they made this platformer with Claude Opus 5.5 in their September 23 X post.

title: Arkenfall
description: Explore the Frayed Vale, fight the Unravelled, and climb the Loomspire in a browser fantasy adventure.
author: Leon Lin (@LexnLin)
ai_note: The creator credits Claude Opus 5.5 for the code, procedural world, sound, and music in their September 23 X post.
